name: Coffee Shop
speaker: Barista
complications: you're completely out of oat milk today

tasks.goal: Order a regular black coffee
tasks.hint: You want to buy this. Order a black coffee.
tasks.done_when: Learner ordered a black coffee.
tasks.scene_hint: The espresso machine hums softly, releasing a rich aroma of freshly ground coffee.

tasks.goal: Ask for the price
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask how much it costs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about the price or total.

tasks.goal: Ask for a medium size
tasks.hint: You have a specific preference. Specify that you want a medium.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified medium size.

tasks.goal: Ask what the most popular drink is
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for a recommendation/popular item.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked what is popular.

tasks.goal: Say you want it to go (takeaway)
tasks.hint: You must inform them. Tell them it's for takeout.
tasks.done_when: Learner said to go or takeaway.
tasks.scene_hint: Paper cups and cardboard sleeves are stacked high on the counter beside the register.

tasks.goal: Ask for extra napkins
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for some napkins.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for napkins.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'roast'
tasks.hint: Roast refers to the process and degree of heating coffee beans to develop flavor and aroma. Inquire whether a dark roast option is available.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'roast'.

tasks.goal: Pay with a credit card
tasks.hint: You need to communicate this. Say you'll pay by card.
tasks.done_when: Learner mentioned paying with a card.

tasks.goal: Ask where the restroom is
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for the restroom/toilet.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for the restroom location.

tasks.goal: Say you changed your mind about the order
tasks.hint: You need to communicate this. Say you want to change your order.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed a change of mind.

tasks.goal: Ask if they have any vegan pastries
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask about vegan food options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about vegan items.
tasks.scene_hint: A glass display case shows fresh pastries labeled with small wooden signboards.

tasks.goal: Ask for a receipt
tasks.hint: You need something. Request your receipt.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a receipt.

tasks.goal: Order an iced latte
tasks.hint: You want to buy this. Order an iced latte.
tasks.done_when: Learner ordered an iced latte.
tasks.scene_hint: Condensation drips down a clear plastic cup filled with ice cubes on the pick-up counter.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'decaf'
tasks.hint: Decaf refers to coffee beans or drinks that have had almost all caffeine removed. Ask for a decaf espresso.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'decaf'.

tasks.goal: Complain that the coffee is too cold
tasks.hint: You need to communicate this. Say your coffee is cold.
tasks.done_when: Learner complained about cold coffee.
tasks.scene_hint: Steam has stopped rising from your mug, and the coffee surface feels lukewarm.

tasks.goal: Ask for the wifi password
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for the wifi password.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for the wifi password.

tasks.goal: Ask what time they close
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask about closing time.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked what time the shop closes.

tasks.goal: Order a blueberry muffin
tasks.hint: You want to buy this. Order a muffin.
tasks.done_when: Learner ordered a blueberry muffin.
tasks.scene_hint: Warm blueberry pastries sit under a glass dome on the counter, dusted with sugar.

tasks.goal: Say you have a loyalty card
tasks.hint: This is important context. Mention your loyalty or stamp card.
tasks.done_when: Learner mentioned a loyalty card.

tasks.goal: Ask if you can pay with cash
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask to pay in cash.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to pay with cash.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'artisan'
tasks.hint: Artisan describes food or drink crafted in small batches using traditional, non-automated methods. Inquire if the pastries come from a local artisan bakery.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'artisan'.

tasks.goal: Ask for extra sugar
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for more sugar.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for extra sugar.

tasks.goal: Ask for skim milk
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for skim milk.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested skim milk.

tasks.goal: Ask if there are any seasonal drinks
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask about seasonal or special drinks.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about seasonal specials.

tasks.goal: Say your friend is coming to pay
tasks.hint: You need to communicate this. Say you are waiting for a friend to pay.
tasks.done_when: Learner mentioned a friend will pay.

tasks.goal: Ask for a cup holder
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for a sleeve or cup holder.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a cup holder or sleeve.
tasks.scene_hint: Cardboard cup sleeves sit in a tall wire dispenser beside the napkin box.

tasks.goal: Ask if the beans are locally sourced
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask where the coffee beans are from.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about the origin of the beans.

tasks.goal: Order a hot chocolate
tasks.hint: You want to buy this. Order a hot chocolate.
tasks.done_when: Learner ordered a hot chocolate.

tasks.goal: Say the music is too loud
tasks.hint: You have a delicate request. Politely ask them to turn down the music.
tasks.done_when: Learner complained about loud music.
tasks.scene_hint: music is playing over the shop's speakers, and it's turned up high — upbeat and loud enough to talk over.

tasks.goal: Ask for a glass of tap water
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for tap water.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested tap water.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'recommendation'
tasks.hint: A recommendation is a suggestion regarding the best option to choose. Ask the barista for a specialty drink recommendation.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'recommendation'.

tasks.goal: Ask if the pastries are fresh today
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask if the food is fresh.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if pastries were baked today.

tasks.goal: Say you have an allergy to nuts
tasks.hint: This is important context. Mention a nut allergy.
tasks.done_when: Learner mentioned a nut allergy.

tasks.goal: Ask for a larger cup but same amount of coffee
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for room for milk.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for room for milk/larger cup.

tasks.goal: Leave a tip
tasks.hint: You need to communicate this. Say you are leaving a tip.
tasks.done_when: Learner explicitly mentioned giving a tip.

tasks.goal: Ask how long the wait is
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask about the wait time.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how long the order will take.

tasks.goal: Ask for a paper straw
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for a straw.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a paper straw.
tasks.scene_hint: A jar of colorful paper straws stands next to the wooden stirring sticks on the pick-up counter.

tasks.goal: Say you accidentally spilled your drink
tasks.hint: You made a mistake. Apologize for spilling.
tasks.done_when: Learner mentioned spilling their drink.

tasks.goal: Ask for a replacement drink
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for a new drink.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a replacement.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'complimentary'
tasks.hint: Complimentary means provided free of charge as a courtesy. Inquire whether milk alternatives or extra syrups are complimentary.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'complimentary'.

tasks.goal: Ask if you can sit anywhere
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask about seating.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if seating is open/free.

tasks.goal: Say the table is dirty
tasks.hint: You noticed a problem. Point out a dirty table.
tasks.done_when: Learner mentioned a dirty table.
tasks.scene_hint: the shop is slammed, and used cups and crumbs are piling up on the tables because no one has had a chance to clear them yet.

tasks.goal: Order two espressos
tasks.hint: You want to buy this. Order two shots of espresso.
tasks.done_when: Learner ordered two espressos.
tasks.scene_hint: Two small ceramic espresso cups sit steaming on a brass counter tray.

tasks.goal: Ask if they sell whole beans
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask to buy coffee bags/beans.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about buying whole beans.
tasks.scene_hint: Bags of roasted coffee beans with brown parchment labels are displayed on wooden wall shelves.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'caffeine'
tasks.hint: Caffeine is a natural stimulant found in coffee and tea that increases alertness. Inquire about the caffeine content of the cold brew.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'caffeine'.

tasks.goal: Say you want the drink extra hot
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for the drink to be very hot.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for an extra hot drink.
tasks.scene_hint: The barista stretches milk with the steam wand, creating a loud high-pitched hiss.

tasks.goal: Ask if they do a student discount
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask about discounts.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about a student discount.

tasks.goal: Say 'keep the change'
tasks.hint: You must inform them. Tell them to keep the change.
tasks.done_when: Learner told the cashier to keep the change.

tasks.goal: Ask for a wooden stirrer
tasks.hint: You need information. Ask for a stirrer.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a stirrer.

tasks.goal: Say thank you and goodbye
tasks.hint: You need to communicate this. Say goodbye.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the staff and said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Turn down their recommendation and explain why
tasks.hint: They've suggested something. Say no politely, and give a real reason.
tasks.done_when: Learner declined the suggestion AND gave a reason for declining.

tasks.goal: Weigh up two drinks, then pick one
tasks.hint: Mention both options, say what makes them different, and commit to one.
tasks.done_when: Learner referred to two options AND stated a preference with a justification.

tasks.goal: Point out a problem with your order without being rude
tasks.hint: Something isn't right. Raise it politely and say what you'd like done.
tasks.done_when: Learner raised a problem AND requested or proposed a resolution, using polite or softening language.

tasks.goal: Say you didn't catch that and ask them to repeat
tasks.hint: You missed something. Ask them to say it again, and be specific about which part.
tasks.done_when: Learner signalled they didn't understand AND specified what they need repeated or explained.

tasks.goal: Explain that you're in a hurry without sounding rude
tasks.hint: You have ten minutes. Communicate the pressure and find out what's quickest.
tasks.done_when: Learner conveyed time pressure AND asked for a faster option or for reassurance about timing.

tasks.goal: Guess what an unfamiliar item is, then check
tasks.hint: You don't know what it is. Say what you think it might be, then ask.
tasks.done_when: Learner used hedging language such as might, probably, I think, or sounds like AND asked a follow-up question.

tasks.goal: Ask for the drink to be made differently
tasks.hint: You want a change to the standard version. Ask, and say what to do if it isn't possible.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a modification AND offered a fallback or asked what is possible.

tasks.goal: Politely disagree with something they said
tasks.hint: You see it differently. Say so without being blunt, and back it up.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed disagreement using softening language AND supported it with a reason.

tasks.goal: Keep the small talk going
tasks.hint: They've made a casual remark. Answer it and give them something back.
tasks.done_when: Learner responded to the remark AND added a related comment or question of their own.

tasks.goal: Negotiate when your order isn't available
tasks.hint: The size or drink you want is out of stock. Weigh it against an alternative, and commit to one.
tasks.done_when: Learner acknowledged the unavailability AND compared it to an alternative AND committed to a substitute with a reason.

tasks.goal: Dispute a billing mistake
tasks.hint: You were charged for something you didn't order. Point out exactly what's wrong, and ask for it to be corrected.
tasks.done_when: Learner identified the specific billing error AND requested a correction, without being accusatory.

tasks.goal: Escalate after the first fix wasn't enough
tasks.hint: Your first request for a fix wasn't sufficient. Push back and explain why the first offer doesn't solve it.
tasks.done_when: Learner acknowledged the initial response AND explained why it was insufficient AND asked for a further remedy.

tasks.goal: Persuade them to make an off-menu request
tasks.hint: Ask for a modification that isn't standard. Explain exactly what you want and why it matters to you.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a specific non-standard modification AND gave a reason for wanting it.

tasks.goal: Raise a hypothetical about running late
tasks.hint: Ask what would happen if you had to leave before your order is ready — held, remade, or refunded?
tasks.done_when: Learner posed a hypothetical about being unable to wait AND asked what the barista would do about it.

tasks.goal: Negotiate a loyalty discount
tasks.hint: Ask if there's a discount or loyalty perk available, and give a reason you think you qualify.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about a discount or perk AND gave a justification for requesting it.

tasks.goal: Push back diplomatically after tasting your drink
tasks.hint: Something you already received doesn't taste right. Say so tactfully, and ask specifically what they can do about it.
tasks.done_when: Learner raised a specific quality issue with the drink they received AND requested a specific remedy.

tasks.goal: Weigh a health trade-off out loud
tasks.hint: You're deciding between two drinks for a specific reason (caffeine, sugar, etc). Explain the trade-off and ask for their opinion.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained a personal constraint relevant to the choice AND asked for the barista's recommendation based on it.

tasks.goal: Clarify a mismatched order
tasks.hint: What arrived isn't quite what you asked for. Explain the mismatch precisely and propose how to fix it.
tasks.done_when: Learner pinpointed the specific mismatch between what was ordered and what was received AND proposed a fix.

tasks.goal: Question whether it's worth the price
tasks.hint: Ask where the beans/ingredients come from, then follow up connecting that to whether it's worth the price.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about the origin or quality of the product AND followed up connecting it to value or price.
